description: Use this when the user wants a birth stats poster, a baby birth announcement printable, a nursery birth print or a birth stats sign. Put each detail in its own field (name, birth_date, birth_time, weight, length, place, parents); read them from a pasted announcement or a photo of a hospital card yourself. Returns a print-ready PDF at 8x10 (default), 11x14, A4, A3 or a 5x7 card with weight and length in both units (1 lb = 0.45359237 kg, 1 in = 2.54 cm), and, when a place is given, the moon phase at birth. Sunrise and sunset need a listed city or, for a place given by coordinates, an explicit IANA timezone. 4 layouts and 6 colour themes. Does not add photos or footprints.

birth_date.description: Date of birth, e.g. "2026-03-03" or "March 3, 2026". Numeric dates like 3/4/2026 are read month first for places in the US and Canada (or with no place) and day first elsewhere; dotted dates (03.04.2026) are always day first. Send YYYY-MM-DD when in doubt.

birth_time.description: Time of birth in local time at the birth place, e.g. "7:42 am" or "19:42". Optional; the poster uses the same 12 or 24 hour style.

bleed.description: Add a 0.125 in bleed on every side for a print shop (default false). The trim size stays as chosen.

color.description: Colour theme: sage (default), blush, sky, sand, charcoal or white.

headline.description: Optional short line above the name, e.g. "Welcome to the world" or "Hello world". Default none.

layout.description: Layout: classic (centered, default), modern (left aligned with a colour band), moon (large moon at the top), or minimal (one line of stats).

length.description: Birth length with its unit, e.g. "20 in", "20.5 inches" or "51 cm". Both units print (1 in = 2.54 cm).

name.description: The baby's name as it should print, in any spelling or script supported by the fonts (Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Vietnamese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi and other Indian scripts), e.g. "Olivia Rose Nguyễn" or "王芳".

parents.description: Optional parents' names, e.g. "Anna & Tom Smith" or ["Anna", "Tom"].

place.description: Birth city, e.g. "Austin, Texas" or "Łódź, Poland". Used for the printed place, the time zone, the moon phase that night and sunrise and sunset. A town that is not in the city list is refused: then send the nearest larger city, or the town with coordinates like "Hebden Bridge, England (53.742, -2.014)" (the name prints as written; add timezone for sunrise and sunset).

show_moon.description: Include the moon phase at the birth date and time (default true).

show_sun.description: Include sunrise and sunset at the birth place on that date (default true when a place is given).

time_format.description: 12h or 24h for printed times. Default: the style of birth_time (24h if it had no am/pm).

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birth place, e.g. "America/Phoenix" or "Europe/London". Needed when the place is given by coordinates (sunrise, sunset and the zone label print only with it) or when no place is given (the moon then uses this zone). A listed city always uses its own zone.

weight.description: Birth weight with its unit, e.g. "7 lb 8 oz", "7.5 lb", "3.4 kg" or "3400 g". Both units print (1 lb = 0.45359237 kg).
